text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! During the break, I 
watched a looooot of videos I'd been 
curious about! And gaming streams are 
super fun!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It was like *bam*, *pow*, *crash*, but 
then the enemies kept chasing after me, 
and I went 'Aaaaahhhh~~!'

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I should show you too, Trainer! Let's 
watch it together, come on~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo seemed to have spent a fun day 
off immersing herself in her hobby.
